name: ATLAS API
docs:
Bruno collection for the Nexorus ATLAS project.

Covers the internal BFF routes (apps/web/app/api/v1/*) and the external TomTom Traffic APIs used by the JasaMarga Ops Command lead.

Open in Bruno (https://www.usebruno.com), select the 'Local' environment, set tomtomKey, then run requests. Most MBG routes need a logged-in session + the local Postgres running; the JasaMarga routes are public and need no setup.
